title: Straps
tagline: Strap is a detailed supply chain management solution, Strap helps to revitalize and bring transformation and transparency to logistics across various organizations and departments.
description:
SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT AT YOUR
FINGERTIP

Strap is your all in one place to track supplies distribution and day to day activities, Straps allows you have a transparent, qualitative and quantitative assessment of your overall processes. There is an age long problem keeping in check and staying updated all elements of supplies for the manufacture of a product, supplies ranging from raw materials to basic instruments can deter the effective production in a company, Strap is a solution to track this processes along the chain using the blockchain technology
how_its_made:
Strap uses the following tools to achieve functionalities that are peculiar to making supply chain management top notch

TABLELAND: Integrated with tableland sdk to create, store and query products metadata to our dapp across all departments

XTMP: Made use of XTMP to integrate a messaging functionality between various departments to help communication

EPNS:Integrated EPNS sdk to trigger push notifications from the dapp to a specific dispatch handler by integrating with epns sdk

ENS: Integrated ENS sdk with the backend server to resolve an ens address for push notifications

NFTPORT: Integrated NFTPort api with the backend server to mint unique nfts for clients onboarded to out platform and minted an unique NFT to companies on successful creation

POLYGON: Deployed the contract on polygon network, to leverage on transaction speed and affordability

FILECOIN: We made use of to store Information in a decentralized manner

UNSTOPPABLE DOMAIN: We created an alternative login route using unstoppable domain

XMTP:  Integrated xmtp sdk to the FE dapp to enable seamless communication between admin operators and dispatch team
